name: Letter Sent Across the Stars
description:
A letter dispatched from a distant place, carrying within it a thin, warmly printed picture book of dreams.

The road was long and winding, yet someone carefully preserved the crayon drawings, tying up the strings and smoothing the creased corners... until they finally reach your hands, where the dreams sealed within the letter remain as fresh as ever.
story:
"Only the hopes and aspirations of children must never be failed."

"Now, it falls to you to guard their dreams. The Interstellar, set sail!"
